questions.name: Burst pipe, Silver: covered, RM25,000 limit, RM1,000 Excess
questions.question: My kitchen pipe burst and water damaged my flooring. I'm Silver tier — am I covered, and how much?

questions.name: Flood, Gold, no Special Perils Extension: not covered
questions.question: My house flooded in the monsoon. I'm Gold tier, no Special Perils Extension. Am I covered?

questions.name: Phone stolen from car in driveway: not covered (exclusion for unattended vehicles / open areas)
questions.question: My phone was stolen from my car in the driveway — what do I claim and how much?
